gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Loud, loose, and a bit theatrical. Paprika scatters its letters at a distance and lets the lowercase swell like capitals, while Noto Sans Elbasan stays modest, with large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Paprika spaces its letters far apart, with counters like a hollow reed cut open. Noto Sans Georgian sits beneath in plain sans, open curves and short ascender stems keeping the text quick to take in.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Paprika's lowercase swells to capital size, with hollow counters like a reed cut open. Noto Sans Glagolitic is the better worker for text: round, open letters stay clear at small sizes, and the tall sturdy body holds steady.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gond: Expressive and commanding, Paprika spreads its letters far apart in a hollow, reed-cut way. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi follows in plain sans, its strokes thick as crayon marks and its terminals cut back to leave a big gap.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Brash, spaced-out display letters with hollow counters. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian follows underneath, and its big open eyes and deep middle band would keep a long passage feeling spacious and clean rather than crowded.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-jp: Paprika is all swagger, scattering its letters far apart while its lowercase grows as large as capitals. Noto Sans JP brings the strongest quality to the pair: a very tall x-height with sweeping open curves that make a sharp counterpoint.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Paprika scatters its letters far apart and makes its lowercase as grand as capitals. Its strongest quality is the way that showy spacing sits above Noto Sans Kaithi, whose e keeps an open channel.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Big, hollow, and full of presence. Paprika has reed-like counters, so shrinking it would lose that swagger, while Noto Sans Kannada already looks at home small, with a gentle bump from lowercase up to capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Paprika's lowercase grows to capital height, with spaced-out letters and counters like a hollow reed cut open. Noto Sans Kayah Li supplies the strongest quality: lifted brush ends and low capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kr: Paprika spreads its letters far apart, with hollow reed-cut counters and a lowercase that grows as large as capitals. Noto Sans KR does the quieter work of text, with generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height.
